name: attention-gradient
title: Attention Gradient
description: A notification list where urgency is a computed number, not a fixed color-coded badge: each channel tracks how many times in a row it's been ignored, and that count directly drives a continuously blended slate-to-amber-to-rose glow plus an ambient pulse that speeds up as it climbs, both real interpolations of the same value rather than swapped CSS classes. Open a channel and it snaps straight back to calm; keep dismissing it with "Not now" and it visibly escalates, with a plain-language readout ("Ignored 2 times in a row") explaining exactly why.
